question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word: IGNOMINY
solution:
The correct answer is: **Disgrace**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Ignominy"** refers to public shame, dishonor, or disgrace. (अपमान)
 
 
• **Example:** The politician faced ignominy after being caught in a corruption scandal.
 
 
• **"Disgrace"** is a synonym for ignominy and means the loss of respect, honor, or esteem; a source of shame. (अपमान)
 
 
• **Example:** Being expelled from the university was a major disgrace for him.
